definition: Extensively investigated exotic candidate means that the ring survived the documented, case-specific campaign of known and newly developed exclusion tests and explicit model searches, including complete finite domains and specified unbounded construction families. It proves neither existence of a fusion category nor novelty of a future realization. Each case lists exactly what was exhausted, what survived and the remaining hypotheses.
